## Scoped mathematical acceptance

Add the complete independent proof audit and continuous-time decision-tree companion for 30005233 / OWR-11101922-005.

**Bérard–Dembin–Marêché's prior-preprint Theorem 1.1 is accepted with explicit local repairs, relative to the stated published Last–Peccati–Yogeshwaran Poisson OSSS input and standard measure/probability foundations.** The accepted scope is absorbing, attractive, finite-rate, finite-range, translation-invariant binary single-site IPS, starting from all one and measured by occupied-origin upper density. Every positive independent death perturbation yields exponential decay when the unperturbed upper density tends to zero. The exact generator identity and time change also establish the strict-phase upper-density dichotomy along G_p = pG_1 + (1-p)D.

The audit checks graphical construction, finite dependence and localization, finite-box limits, Russo differentiation, absolute add-one influence versus mark pivotality, every continuous-OSSS hypothesis, revealment, differential inequality, calculus and parameter conversion. The companion supplies the complete all-finite-configuration CTDT stopping, measurability, continuity, increment and determination argument.

## Corrections, attribution and acceptance limits

The [BDM source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11424v2) remains a prior preprint on the bounded primary-record checks reported in the audit. Credit for the sharpness proof belongs to Bérard, Dembin and Marêché. The external [LPY input](https://doi.org/10.1002/rsa.21136) is published in Random Structures & Algorithms 63(2) (2023), 457–511; its exact hypotheses were inspected in [arXiv v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.07180v3), Corollary 4.1 and (3.2)–(3.5). No publisher-PDF byte or pagination comparison is claimed, and LPY itself is not reproved.

The p. 3 spatial shift and p. 15 translated initial box require correction. The p. 17 first logarithmic bound is already correct; **only the following limsup display swaps the parameter arguments**. This explicitly supersedes the earlier applicability report's overbroad wording about two displayed bounds. Pivotality finite dependence, all-configuration CTDT conventions and threshold-set downward closure are supplied in full.

The full proof audit, CTDT companion, acceptance summary and public source metadata are byte-identical to the accepted originals. ACCEPTANCE.json only receives edition-relative links, exact report identities and edition limitations, and drops an obsolete historical publication flag. No mathematical statement or caveat is altered.

The broader cleaned record remains unclosed. No general finite-seed survival sharpness, arbitrary parameter curves, critical-endpoint behavior, nonabsorbing sharpness, infinite-range or simultaneous multiple-site theorem, or topological Corollary 1.2 is accepted. AI-assisted and unrefereed; no new proof-search turn, novelty claim, external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification.

## Repository and disclosure boundary

Exactly nine files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005233/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated content or historical status/turn accounting changes. The packet contains authored mathematical audits, scoped acceptance and public bibliographic/verification metadata only. Copied source documents, extracted source text, images, datasets, private material, scripts and logs are excluded. No merge, release, DOI deposit or outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

Original acceptance/manifest identities, byte-identical report preservation, exact editorial differences, public source PDF identity rehashes, UTF-8/JSON, relative links, manifest, allowlist and exclusion checks passed. The addition-only patch passed strict-whitespace clean replay with exact path and byte matching. A fresh base tree chain was read and independently rehashed, preserving all unrelated entries including QUEUE.md. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification or a hosted-CI pass. Exact-head remote readback remains a separate publication check.

Base: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
